additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
mr. Chetoauh raised this ticket where the charger doesn't recognize the Payment Terminal:
mqtt: pt/statusenquiry/response {"status":"error","message":"no
terminal connected","details":"no terminal connected"}
possible causes:
Network cable defect or not connected
Network switch defect
Power supply of payment terminal defect or not connected
IP-address of payment terminal wrong
possible solutions:
Check network configuration of payment-terminal:
Static IP-address: 10.20.17.50
Subnetmask: 255.255.255.0
Gateway: 10.20.17.2
DNS: 10.20.17.2
Ping terminal (IP: 10.20.17.50)
If none of these solutions work, please replace the Terminal.
